findings.note: purge orphans is destructive: it deletes rows from judgments, citations, sentences, and jid_refs in the local store and writes a change_log entry. The 'orphans' name matches the read heuristic by accident; the body mutates state (lines 81-87 of novel_purge_window.go), so a readOnlyHint=true would be a real bug per AGENTS.md ("Wrong annotations are worse than missing ones"). Default destructive hint is correct.
